issues.detail: deadline_iso is '2025-01-01' but no computed deadline date appears in draft_markdown; however next_steps states 'the 2-year limitation period runs from [TO CONFIRM — agreed possession date]' — the deadline_iso value of 2025-01-01 is derived by adding 2 years to the cause-of-action date 2023-01-01, yet this computed deadline (2025-01-01) is never disclosed to the reviewer in the draft, and TODAY (2026-09-20) is already past that deadline, which is a material procedural gap that must be surfaced
issues.fix: Add an explicit notice in next_steps (or a flagged note in the draft) stating: 'IMPORTANT: The 2-year limitation period computed from the cause-of-action date of 2023-01-01 expired on 2025-01-01. TODAY is 2026-09-20, which is past that deadline. A condonation of delay application will be required. Confirm with supervising advocate before filing.' The draft must not leave this gap invisible.
